allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== Proceso Docker Desktop ==="; $p = Get-Process 'Docker Desktop' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { Write-Output "corriendo \(PID $\($p.Id\)\)" } else { Write-Output "NO esta corriendo" }; Write-Output "=== Servicio com.docker.service ==="; $s = Get-Service 'com.docker.service' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($s\) { Write-Output "$\($s.Status\) / inicio: $\($s.StartType\)" } else { Write-Output "servicio no encontrado" }; Write-Output "=== WSL ==="; wsl --status; Write-Output "=== Distros WSL ==="; wsl --list --verbose)

PowerShell(foreach \($c in @\('make','docker-compose'\)\) { $g = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($g\) { Write-Output "$c = $\($g.Source\)" } else { Write-Output "$c = NO ENCONTRADO" } }; Write-Output "=== docker compose v2 \(plugin\) ==="; docker compose version 2>$null; if \(-not $?\) { Write-Output "no disponible sin daemon o no instalado" })
